definition: Knowledge is the cognitive side of consciousness. It can mean either direct acquaintance or recognition of something, or a more developed understanding reached through intellectual comparison and expressed in judgment; the term is also sometimes used for what is known as a body of information, and in some contexts for certainty grounded on adequate objective support.
